bottleneck.note: Easter campaign postmortem: 16 checks over ~32 hours, zero action. This is a pattern. Creative gets built, tools get built, and then sits. The system needs a default-action trigger: 'tool is live → first send happens within 48 hours OR Chief escalates to TJ directly.' Adding this as the compounding improvement.

compoundingImprovement.suggestion: 48-Hour Activation Rule: When any new action tool goes live (email blast kit, ad variations, calling hub), Chief triggers a cron reminder 48 hours post-publish. If zero activity is logged (no 'sent' markers in localStorage export, no call log entry), Chief sends a direct Telegram alert: 'Tool [X] has been live 48 hours with zero sends. Revenue at stake: $[Y]. Next step: [specific action].' This converts passive tool availability into active obligation.
compoundingImprovement.compoundingRationale: The pattern of 'build the tool, skip the launch' has now cost at minimum: Easter campaign (potential $840 LTV), 3 weeks of commercial calls. A systematic activation rule converts every tool build into a time-gated revenue event. This compounds because every future tool inherits the rule automatically.
